## Description
Please include a summary of the change, relevant motivation, and context.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI/CD or build pipeline optimization

## Quality & Validation Checklist
- [ ] I have executed `npm test` locally and all 8 checks passed with 0 errors.
- [ ] I have verified strict XML well-formedness with `xmllint` or `scripts/validate-xml.js`.
- [ ] I have tested uploading the XML template to Blogger without parsing errors.
- [ ] Any new assets are properly referenced in jsDelivr CDN mappings and documented.
